Old chooseFounderActivity DELETED; tick and wait-step re-choice both use the scorer. E reports the WHY with scores. Three probe-caught fixes: (1) builder pin — latent in 1058, a builder who chose eat was pinned to the site and could not eat or build (~90s stall); (2) site held while away — the 1058 doc stated it but the code never had it, a resting builder kept the site reserved ~45s empty; (3) deforestation cliff — pre-existing 1057 design, only 8 trees within the 30-tile work radius, so the rebuild stalled forever at 1/6 (nearest tree 31 away); fix: radius 30-60 (46 trees, ~7 huts of headroom). Follow-up NOT built: sustainable wood supply (replanting/forestry) before the settlement grows past ~7 huts. BUILD 1060: NPC memory + relationships (G26) — new pure module memory.ts (226 lines), wired into the tick, the scorer, E, and the save — porting only the memory/relationship part of villageLife.ts, adapted to 3D. Affinity 0-100, everyone starts at neutral 50 — earned, never seeded. Shared events: building together +4, resting together +3, eating together +2, sleeping under the same roof +1. Decays 1/day toward 50 (lazy, never crossing 50). Memories capped at 12 per founder (oldest first out), forgotten when older than 30 days. The scorer rest choice carries a companionship premium (0.15 x (closestAffinity-50)/50 x need(social), paid only when the closest founder is actually at camp; neutral company adds exactly 0) and the rest destination is a tile beside the closest founder (first walkable orthogonal tile, N/W/E/S, taken tiles skipped, camp-centre fallback). E reports the relationship with real counts — probe example: Marlow: sleep (sleep 0.81 > work 0.52) · hunger 80 · energy 10 · social 60 · closest Perrin 59 — ate 1x, rested 2x, slept 1x. Save: ag-3d-founders-v1 bumped 2-3 with migration (v2 gets fresh neutral social; v3 validated — clamps, drops self/unknown names and bad memory types; unknown → null); field named socialState (the save social was already the needs number — a collision tsc caught). 43 standalone asserts ALL PASS (parent re-ran directly from source); sim +33 (384,875 passed / 51 failed — parent re-ran with totals printed; pristine 384,842/51 from the full log — the pristine COUNT bundle run crashed on a missing worktree asset, public/mobs/bat_sheet.png; the baseline stands on the completed full log). Two real catches: a missed 1058 assert (founders save is v2) failed the first full run (52 failures) — fixed to v3 and re-run (51); a decay-arithmetic error in an assert (54 after 5 days decays to 50, not 49 — the clamp — the code was right).
